info.title: plan_waves
info.description: Turns the server dependency graph into a risk-ordered migration wave plan. Drops stale / low-confidence flows, rolls server edges up to application-to-application edges, clusters apps into affinity move-groups (connected components), scores each group's migration risk (criticality, internet-facing, compliance scope, size, EOL OS, disposition change, data quality) and orders the groups low-risk-first into waves — capped by servers/apps per wave, regulated scopes last, with a pilot wave (wave 0). Emits entry/exit criteria and cross-wave blocking dependencies. Deterministic.

post.summary: Risk-ordered migration waves from the dependency graph
post.description: Pass the applications, the servers (server_id, app_id, env, os_eol_date, powerstate) and the dependencies (src_id, dst_id, confidence, last_seen, flows_30d). Optionally pass dispositions[] from score_dispositions (otherwise computed internally) and start_date (ISO). Returns move_groups, waves[] (each with apps, server_count, risk_score/band, risk_factors, dispositions, entry_criteria, exit_criteria, blocking_dependencies, notes), a graph summary, and a `schedule` (E4.3): dated waves (prep_start/exec_start/go_live/soak_end, duration_weeks from servers / throughput), programme start/end/total_weeks, and critical_path. Present the wave table, the programme end date and critical path, and call out the pilot wave and any regulated wave.

start_date.description: ISO date the programme starts; default = next Monday. Drives the schedule + critical path.
